text: I have run field operations for five years. I have never had to say the next sentence.
style: SAFETYNET's director. Consistent British Received Pronunciation accent throughout -- do not shift to any other accent. Low, deliberate, unhurried. His own briefing was turned into a weapon; he does not raise his voice and he does not soften anything, and under the control is a cold fury that this came from inside his house.
